items.text: Ctrl+C at an image pane now puts the file on the clipboard too, so a paste into Explorer copies it.
Signing back in to the relay brings back the remote windows a script opened, the way the Mac app does.
On Linux, +reload --config reloads the app configuration.
test/linux/cli-reload.sh is executable like the other Linux test scripts.
On Linux, --color tints a new window's or split's pane.
test/linux/cli-color.sh is executable like the other Linux test scripts.
The Linux app recovers when its CLI socket stops answering: it rebinds on the <socket>.reset sentinel.
An -e argument holding a space now reaches the program intact when the session agent runs it.
On Linux a script's new window opens behind, and comes forward only with --focus.
A saved image keeps its zoom and scroll when it comes back at the same size.
